plain_summary: The page begins by listing hourly fees for launch services, differentiating between large and small launches and specific ports (All Ports, Ngqura/Port Elizabeth). It then includes a note on special conditions for tugs/vessels involved in salvage operations. The main section, '3.8 BERTHING SERVICES', defines the scope of these services (e.g., entering/leaving port, shifting berth, engine trials) and clarifies that berthing and unberthing are charged as two separate services. A table provides basic berthing fees and additional charges per 100 tons for various ports (Richards Bay, Port Elizabeth/Ngqura, Cape Town, Saldanha, Other Ports). Finally, the page details a 50% surcharge applicable under specific conditions (outside ordinary working hours, cancelled standby, or late vessel arrival/departure) and a separate hourly fee for berthing staff attending tanker vessels at Mossel Bay and Saldanha Bay.
